name: frameless
description: macOS: hide the title bar, pin the traffic lights to the left of the editor tabs, keep the window draggable.

x.description: Left offset of the traffic lights, in points.

y.description: Top offset of the traffic lights, in points. 14 centers the 14pt macOS 26 lights on the 35px tab row (measured).

frameless.trafficLights.description: Where macOS places the traffic lights. Changing this needs a full relaunch; Frameless: Apply does that.

frameless.stylesheet.markdownDescription: CSS file applied to the workbench (absolute path; `~/` is expanded). Empty applies no styling beyond the title-bar layout. Copied in at Apply, so run **Frameless: Apply** after editing it. See `examples/one-dark.css` in the repo.

frameless.watermark.markdownDescription: Image shown in the empty editor (SVG, PNG, JPG or WebP). Absolute path; `~/` is expanded. Empty keeps VS Code's logo, or the one your stylesheet sets. Run **Frameless: Apply** after changing it.
